fields.description: Issue includes letters to the editor about health and sanitation conditions in Miami-area tourist camps and concerns about malaria; local column items and announcements; notices about the Pan American Civil Service Institute opening; discussion of liquor regulation and enforcement in Florida; and entertainment listings and advertisements including wrestling at Biscayne Fronton and theatre calendars, along with local business advertising in Miami, Miami Beach, and Coral Gables.
